description: Use this when the user asks how much of a US company ETFs own, or what share of its stock sits in ETFs. Returns a lower bound: at least this percent of the shares outstanding is held by the covered US ETFs, from this many funds, with the shares held, the SEC's count of shares outstanding and its date, the holdings dates, the method, whether the percent is of the whole company or of the ticker's class, and where the figure ranks among the stocks measured. It is a lower bound because ETFs outside the coverage are not counted. A stock without a figure comes back with the reason. Not for the list of funds that hold the stock (stock_exposure).

ticker.description: A US stock ticker, for example NVDA or BRK.B. BRK-B and BRK/B are read as BRK.B.

name: etf_ownership

basis.description: company when every class is counted, class when the ticker's class alone is.

etf_ownership_pct_at_least.description: The percent of the shares outstanding held by the covered US ETFs, at least.

rank_by_pct_held.description: 1 for the stock most held by percent.

title: ETF ownership of a stock
